children.name: Carlemannia congesta Hook.fil.
children.description: The native range of this species is Sikkim. It is a perennial or subshrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Carlemannia griffithii Benth.
children.description: The native range of this species is C. Himalaya to N. Myanmar. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Carlemannia tetragona Hook.fil.
children.description: The native range of this species is Assam to China (S. Yunnan, NW. Guangxi) and N. Indo-China, NE. Sumatera. It is a perennial or subshrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Silvianthus bracteatus Hook.fil.
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Himalaya to China (Yunnan) and Myanmar. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Silvianthus tonkinensis  Ridsdale
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Yunnan) to N. Indo-China. It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
